build_compilergym_wheel: build a compiler_gym wheel package using python setup.py bdist_wheel with custom py3 none tags
get_wheel_filename: get the wheel filename for compiler_gym by running python setup.py --get-wheel-filename without building
configure_build_dir: configure the compiler_gym build directory by passing --build-dir to python setup.py
exclude_package_modules: exclude specific Python modules like make_specs.py and random_eval.py from the compiler_gym package build
enable_llvm_mlir_envs: enable optional LLVM and MLIR environment packages in compiler_gym based on config flags
